title: Hunger Games Director Hopes GTA 6 Won't Steal All the Spotlight
description: Francis Lawrence, director of the upcoming BioShock movie, recently talked with IGN about his favorite video games and joked about the massive attention on GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Cultural Shadow of GTA 6 in the Entertainment Industry

When a titan of the gaming industry like Grand Theft Auto VI approaches its launch, its gravitational pull affects the entire entertainment landscape. Recently, Francis Lawrence—director of Netflix’s upcoming *BioShock* movie and the *Hunger Games* franchise—sat down with IGN to discuss his all-time favorite video games, leading to some lighthearted industry banter.

## A Director Who Knows His Games

During his interview with IGN Games, Lawrence opened up about his gaming background. As the media outlet aptly noted, it's clear that he "knows ball" when it comes to video games. However, amid the discussion of interactive entertainment, the conversation inevitably circles back to the cultural phenomenon surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece.

As the hype train for GTA 6 continues to dominate news feeds and player discussions worldwide, creators across film and television are well aware of the sheer magnitude of attention the game commands. Lawrence playfully expressed hope that fans won't be too distracted by the allure of GTA 6 to check out his own projects, such as *Sunrise on the Reaping*. It's a humorous nod to the reality that competing for audience attention in an era dominated by mega-hits is no easy feat.

## Editor's Take

Francis Lawrence’s lighthearted remarks highlight just how massive the cultural footprint of GTA 6 truly is. When Hollywood directors are playfully competing for mindshare against a video game, you know we are living through a historic moment in entertainment history.
